same.derivedFlags: ReparsePoint derives from Attributes and SymbolicLink from ReparseTag, which Same compares

query.buffer: AllocHGlobal followed by native call and copy; FreeHGlobal in finally
query.errors: Failed native query raises Win32Exception; no deadline/cancellation in this function

open.invalidHandle: Capture Win32 error, dispose invalid handle, throw Win32Exception

fromHandle.decode: Fixed offsets using BitConverter; volume identifier and 128-bit file identifier recorded
fromHandle.consistencyCheck: Basic attributes must equal attribute-tag attributes
fromHandle.pathField: Supplied label, not a resolved final path measurement

named.plainPathAuthority: Helper returns metadata; collector separately applies path/drive/ancestor and plain-kind checks
named.deadline: No local timer or token; caller stopwatch checks do not interrupt this call

hash.noSingleLinkRefusal: LinkCount participates in Same but this helper does not require exactly one link; canonical plain() still does
hash.read: ReadAsync with cancellation token, synchronously waited through GetAwaiter/GetResult
hash.preReadTimeout: Stopwatch elapsed >= timeoutMilliseconds refuses before each read
hash.readCount: Zero breaks; positive bytes increment total; total above maxBytes or initial Size refuses before digest append
afterEof: Named(path) while original handle remains open
hash.openedStable: Same(opened-before,opened-after) and BytesRead equals initial Size
hash.readShareOnlyField: Constant default true documenting chosen open flags; not independent enforcement evidence
hash.exceptions: Propagate to collector after structured using unwinding; there is no catch/retry in Hash
deadlineLimitations: Cancellation source is created after open/metadata/stream setup with the full timeout, not the stopwatch remainder
Synchronous open/query and awaited read may block past the requested time
No post-read check before positive-byte digest work or EOF follow-up metadata
Final timeout check precedes digest result construction and all disposal; no post-disposal acceptance check
Per-pass collector stopwatch is independent of Hash timer; no complete invocation hard bound

ownership.privateHelper: Existing private evidence implementation; unchanged and not copied to product
ownership.canonicalFix: Public inventory hash_file cooperative deadline propagation; not a replacement equality rule
ownership.alreadyRepaired: Supervisor lifecycle stream caps/EOF/error/settlement and reserved writer deadline/readback composition remain unchanged
